name: agentic-harness
description: Compass: a conversational onboarding assistant for junior developers, built under an AI harness where the coding agent works to a written contract. React + TypeScript + Vite chat with Claude or local Ollama engines, streaming, persistence, and headless-Chrome verification.

paragraphs: A conversational onboarding assistant for junior developers: it answers questions about a team's codebase and conventions during the first weeks on the job.
This repository is also an AI harness: the coding agent that builds Compass works under a written contract, and every item it delivers comes with a plan, tests and recorded evidence.

Status (Sprint 4, week 8): live at agentichs.netlify.app (v0.3.1). All 13 backlog items are done. Compass talks to a real model, answers from the team's documents in knowledge/ and cites them (the app checks every cited file), suggests starter questions, keeps the conversation across browser restarts, and manages an onboarding to-do list. Say "remind me to ask Ana how deploys work", "what's on my list?" or "mark the deploy one as done": the app performs it on stored data and shows a confirmation built from what was saved.
